October 09, 2026

Board releases survey results

The Board on Friday released the results of its triennial survey, which provides the public and policymakers with detailed insights into the economic condition of families.

The data provide a representative picture of what families own, how and how much they borrow, and how they bank. Alongside the data, the Board issued a summary report (PDF).

  • Real median family income rose 7 percent between the surveys.
  • The homeownership rate was 66 percent, about unchanged.
